```python
def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}
    return [[v for j, v in enumerate(row) if j not in cols] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i not in rows]

def upscale(grid, factor):
    """Each cell as a factor x factor block of its color."""
    return [[v for v in row for _ in range(factor)] for row in grid for _ in range(factor)]

def crop(grid, top, left, height, width):
    """The height x width subgrid whose top-left cell is (top, left)."""
    return [row[left:left + width] for row in grid[top:top + height]]

def trim(grid):
    """The grid without its outermost rows and columns."""
    return [row[1:-1] for row in grid[1:-1]]

def replace(grid, old, new):
    """The grid with every cell of color old recolored new."""
    return [[new if v == old else v for v in row] for row in grid]

def hperiod(grid):
    """The smallest p such that every row repeats itself every p cells: the grid's width if none is smaller."""
    w = len(grid[0])
    return next(p for p in range(1, w + 1) if all(row[j] == row[j - p] for row in grid for j in range(p, w)))

# one task's program: the one shape, cut out by dropping every one-color row and column, mirrored left to right
from lib import compress
def transform(grid):

# another's: every cell as a block whose side is the number of colors other than the background
from lib import upscale
def transform(grid):
    return upscale(grid, len({v for row in grid for v in row}) - 1)
```

lib='''from collections import Counter

def separator_blocks(grid, sep=None):
    """Split the grid into blocks between full rows/columns of one separator color, as (r0,r1,c0,c1) spans; the separator color is inferred if not given."""
    H, W = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    if sep is None:
        full = {r[0] for r in grid if len(set(r)) == 1}
        full |= {row[0] for row in grid if all(len(set(row)) == 1 for row in grid)}  # fallback
        cand = [c for c in full if any(all(v == c for v in r) for r in grid) and any(all(r[j] == c for r in grid) for j in range(W))]
        sep = cand[0]
    rows = [i for i, r in enumerate(grid) if all(v == sep for v in r)]
    cols = [j for j in range(W) if all(r[j] == sep for r in grid)]
    def spans(idxs, n):
        out, start = [], 0
        for i in idxs + [n]:
            if start < i:
                out.append((start, i))
            start = i + 1
        return out
    return sep, [(r0, r1, c0, c1) for r0, r1 in spans(rows, H) for c0, c1 in spans(cols, W)]

def block_marker_grid(grid, sep=None):
    """Per separator block: the background color if the block has at most one non-background non-separator cell, else 1."""
    sep, blocks = separator_blocks(grid, sep)
    inner = [v for row in grid for v in row if v != sep]
    bg = Counter(inner).most_common(1)[0][0]
    rspan = sorted({(r0, r1) for r0, r1, _, _ in blocks})
    cspan = sorted({(c0, c1) for _, _, c0, c1 in blocks})
    out = []
    for r0, r1 in rspan:
        row = []
        for c0, c1 in cspan:
            n = sum(1 for i in range(r0, r1) for j in range(c0, c1) if grid[i][j] != sep and grid[i][j] != bg)
            row.append(bg if n <= 1 else 1)
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''
